title: South Korea tells island residents to take shelter after Russian military aircraft approach
summary_full: The order was issued after aircraft entered the country’s air defence identification zone over the island of UlleungdoResidents of a remote South Korean island were ordered to take shelter on Tuesday morning after several Russian military aircraft came close to entering its airspace, prompting a pre-emptive alert from the military that anticipated a violation.The defence ministry said it would summon the Russian defence attaché on Tuesday afternoon to lodge a strong protest.
